assumes.ja: 確率で付く効果を期待値で持つ（1 発ごとに値 3 の % × その発の弾丸命中率で付き、持続中に付けば上書き延長）。窓の値は付いている確率 × 値 1
assumes.en: The chance-based effect is modelled as an expectation (each shot applies it with value 3 % × the shot's bullet hit rate; a new hit while active refreshes it). The window value is the probability of being active × value 1

assumes.ja: 説明文にきっかけが無いアクティブ型のスキルで、射撃に依らず戦闘開始から 9 秒ごとに付く（CT 9 秒は録画 282 から読んだ値）。最大装弾数は C-0017 の形（加算して四捨五入。Lv10 で 128）。残弾は増やさず、リロードで新しい最大まで込める
assumes.en: An active skill with no trigger in the description: applied every 9 s from the start of combat regardless of firing (the 9 s cooldown was read from recording 282). Max ammo follows C-0017 (additive ratio, rounded; 128 at Lv10). Current ammo is not increased; a reload fills to the new maximum

assumes.ja: 攻撃範囲内の敵は単体ボスで 1 ヒット。ヒットの遅れは未測定（発動と同じフレーム）
assumes.en: Enemies in range are a lone boss, so it lands once. The hit delay is unmeasured (same frame as the activation)
